# Copper Wren Movement Studio: 2029 Class and Trial Guide

The Thursday Aerial Basics class accepts beginners aged 13 or older.
Thursday Aerial Basics starts at 18:10 in Alder Room.
The Monday Rhythm Lab starts at 16:45 in Birch Room.
A trial class costs $31 and must be arranged by the office.
The $31 trial fee is credited to the first term only when enrolment occurs within 10 calendar days of the trial.
A published class listing does not guarantee a place.
A student younger than 13 needs written teacher approval for Aerial Basics.
The spring lab runs from 9 September to 13 September 2029.
Spring lab registration closes at 17:00 on 23 August 2029.
The Friday Floorwork class accepts students aged 10 or older.
Friday Floorwork begins at 17:20 in Cedar Room.
